$comment: HOW THIS FILE WORKS
This is a fitlog program file. The app ships with this copy as a built-in
demo; the same format is used for personal program files imported into the
app (the 'Load program' button, or sharing the file to the installed app on
Android). An imported file replaces the whole program list at once. Weights
entered during workouts are stored separately on the device — never here.
Top level:
programs - non-empty array of programs, one per training day; the picker
screen lists them in this order. Ids must be unique.
Program fields:
id        - string, stable key. Weight history is stored under the pair
(program id, exercise id), so renaming an id detaches the
history attached to it. Never reuse or rename ids.
name      - string, the card title on the picker, e.g. 'Workout A'.
day       - string shown above the name, e.g. 'Tuesday'. Display only.
exercises - non-empty array, shown in this order. Ids unique within the
program.
Exercise fields:
id            - string, stable key; same rule as the program id.
name          - string shown on the exercise card.
sets          - optional positive integer. Omit it for warm-ups and
similar unstructured work; when present the card shows
'sets×reps' and the weight can be split per set.
reps          - string, display only. Free form: '10-12', '8 per side',
'20-30 sec per side', '5 min'.
tracksWeight  - optional boolean, default true. Set false for bodyweight
or timed work: the card then shows no weight controls.
initialWeight - optional number, kg to prefill before any history exists.
note          - optional string, a one-line technique cue shown under the
exercise name and highlighted on the guide screen.
guide         - optional object; when present the exercise thumbnail
opens a technique screen (marked with '?').
Guide fields:
steps  - non-empty array of strings, one instruction per list item.
images - optional array of photos, usually two: start and end position.
Every image is self-contained: a data URL of the form
'data:image/jpeg;base64,<base64-encoded bytes>' (jpeg, png and
webp all work). scripts/pack-program.mjs builds such a file
from a folder with plain image files, but the data URLs can
just as well be written directly without any script.
Every imported file is validated against the rules above; a file that
breaks them is refused with the reason shown on the button. Unknown fields,
including this $comment, are ignored and dropped on import. That covers
'weightStep' too: the -/+ step used to live here and is now fixed by the
app, so a file written before that change still imports (see ADR-0008).

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.note: Short range: stop before the pelvis tucks

steps: Feet shoulder width on the middle of the platform, back and hips flat against the seat.
Lower only as far as the pelvis stays pinned to the seat. The moment the tailbone starts to curl up, the range is over.
Press through the heels and stop short of locking the knees.
Prefer more weight over more depth: depth is what loads the spine here, not the weight.
Set the seat height so the handles line up with the middle of the chest.
Back and head stay against the pad for the whole set.
Press until the elbows are almost straight, then return under control.
Do not let the shoulders roll forward at the end of the press.
